name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Lets both parties share confidential information for a stated purpose while protecting it from further disclosure.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.example: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the MNDA takes effect

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: How long the MNDA lasts
fields.example: Expires 1 year from Effective Date, or continues until terminated

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information stays protected
fields.example: 2 years from Effective Date, but for trade secrets until they are no longer trade secrets; or in perpetuity

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose laws govern the MNDA

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: City or county and state of the courts for disputes

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Optional changes to the Standard Terms

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement takes effect

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: Date of the Order Form

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: Length of each subscription term

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal
fields.example: 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: Support the Provider will provide
fields.example: Email support on business days, 9am-5pm ET

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: Jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement
fields.example: The laws of the State of Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts with jurisdiction over disputes
fields.example: The state and federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's total liability
fields.example: The fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Claims the Customer must defend and indemnify against

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Claims the Provider must defend and indemnify against
fields.example: Claims that the Cloud Service infringes third-party IP

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: Data processing agreement between the parties, if any
fields.example: None, or the Common Paper DPA attached to this Agreement

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms used with a Cloud Service Agreement: target uptime, support response times and service credits.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: Subscription term the SLA applies to

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Monthly availability commitment

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Service credit if uptime falls below target

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Maintenance windows excluded from uptime

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: Time to respond to support requests

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Service credit for missed response times

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where support requests are sent

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date

fields.description: Limits on use, such as seats or installations

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How and when fees are paid

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long the software warranty lasts

fields.label: Deletion Procedure

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: Jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement
fields.example: The laws of the State of Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts with jurisdiction over disputes

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Governs a provider's processing of customer personal data as processor or subprocessor, addressing GDPR and similar laws.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The underlying agreement this DPA supplements

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What processing is done and why
fields.example: Hosting and processing data to provide the Cloud Service

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: Types of personal data processed

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Sensitive data processed, if any

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra safeguards for special category data

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often personal data is transferred
fields.example: Continuous for the duration of the Agreement

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long processing continues
fields.example: For the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the Provider may use

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security incidents

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: Provider's security measures
